req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-023 requires that deleting a task persists the removal so a subsequent GET returns 404. The suite covers: (1) positive/EP — create then delete returns 204, subsequent GET returns exactly 404; (2) negative/NEG — deleting a non-existent task returns exactly 404; (3) boundary/BVA — delete task with id=1 (lowest valid id boundary) and verify persistence; (4) STC — full state transition: created → deleted → confirmed absent; (5) DT — double-delete returns 404 on second attempt, confirming idempotent absence. Each test uses in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory DB override to remain deterministic and isolated.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Fresh in-memory SQLite database with empty tasks table
A task is created via POST /tasks/
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Delete Me' to obtain task_id
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with valid task payload
DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body
GET returns HTTP 404 confirming persistence of deletion
trace: R-TASK-023: system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionTest = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionTest()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Delete Me", "description": None, "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(task_id, int)

    r_delete = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_delete.status_code == 204
    assert r_delete.content == b""

    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 404
    detail = r_get.json()["detail"]
    assert str(task_id) in detail

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

tests.name: test_full_state_transition_created_to_deleted_to_absent
preconditions: Fresh in-memory SQLite database with empty tasks table
actions: GET /tasks/ — verify task absent from list
expected: First GET returns 200 with correct task data
trace: R-TASK-023: state transition coverage — created → deleted → confirmed absent in all read paths
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionTest = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionTest()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_full_state_transition_created_to_deleted_to_absent():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "STC Task", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    tid = r1.json()["id"]

    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{tid}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["id"] == tid
    assert r2.json()["title"] == "STC Task"

    r3 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tid}")
    assert r3.status_code == 204

    r4 = client.get(f"/tasks/{tid}")
    assert r4.status_code == 404

    r5 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r5.status_code == 200
    ids_in_list = [t["id"] for t in r5.json()]
    assert tid not in ids_in_list

test_full_state_transition_created_to_deleted_to_absent()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
